title: Cleveland and the band's growing reputation
summary: In Cleveland, Freddie Webster and Howard McGhee sit in as word spreads about the hip young band.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: There's something else I wanted to mention about Charlie Parker....

Anyway, we finished that engagement, and went to Cleveland. From St. Louis to Cleveland, Ohio, I think -- yeah. That's where we ran into I think Freddie Webster and Howard McGhee, who were there at that particular time. I remember them coming that night and sitting in with the band. And the band was really beginning to get popping, beginning to be known through the grapevine around the country that Billy Eckstine had this band and it had all the "hip" cats in it, and everybody was playing this music that was the young man's fancy, you know.
